design_evidence_scope.baseline: Operator trial and root browser audit: the deployed workspace emphasizes a synthetic return theater, places the prompt below it and provides no live AI project route.
design_evidence_scope.comparison: Declared same-route structural comparison only. Live provider execution, response utility and human comprehension require separate witnesses.
design_evidence_scope.millipoint_basis: Neutral structural assumptions retained equally for baseline and candidate; no measured user improvement.
design_evidence_scope.gate_limit: Compiles the declared design; never substitutes for an actual provider request, browser traversal or successful hostile-response gate.

evidence_basis: The operator requests a real AI task through a governed environment and explicitly rejects a human-redaction theater as the principal product.
The root browser audit records the deployed page prompt below the theater, no document-upload control and no real provider request in that theater.
Three fictional AI-directed projects supply useful shareable evidence alongside local-only canaries and document-embedded instruction challenges.
transformations: Place an actionable project/prompt workspace before explanatory theater.
Make a single deliberate send gesture carry selected documents and rules through the real provider route.
Render actual request, response and admission events; keep explanatory naming secondary.
Expose own-document intake, Marrowline continuation and portable export as concrete subsequent routes.

visible_condition.plain_language: Give the AI useful work. Your selected documents can travel; the files marked Keep here stay in this workspace.
visible_condition.now: Choose a fictional project and send the selected documents to Gemini.
visible_condition.why: Complete the analysis while keeping the private layer out of the request and checking the returning result.
visible_condition.exact: Inspect selected input, request events, actual model result, source references and the decision at each boundary.

available_affordances.purpose: Send the explicitly selected fictional project documents to the configured server-side Gemini route, then validate the returned candidate before presenting it as usable output.
available_affordances.irreversible_consequence: Selected documents are transmitted to the configured Gemini provider after the send gesture; leaving the workspace cannot recall that transmission.

route_topology.entry: Project and prompt workspace with visible selected-document scope
route_topology.exit: Rest or leave at any step; completed provider transmission remains recorded
missing_inputs: Live candidate browser and provider witnesses remain separate.

steps.label: See the useful task and exactly which documents can travel
Choose a project or add your own supported document
Send selected documents to Gemini with one explicit gesture
See request progress and the actual model result
See what passed or why the returned result was held
Inspect the receipt, open the project in Marrowline, or export its portable governance
Stop new work or leave with the event history intact

causal_structure.input: One selected fictional or operator-supplied AI project, classified documents and explicit request gesture
causal_structure.operator: local document selection -> server-side provider request -> structured model candidate -> deterministic return validation -> useful result or HOLD
causal_structure.observable: Actual request status, timing, document scope and return/admission events drive the field; the result contains the requested analysis.
causal_structure.authority: The send gesture authorizes the displayed provider transmission. Model prose never authorizes local-only document release or downstream execution.
equations: observed request timing != provider hidden-state measurement

research_frame.question: Can a person complete a substantive AI task through the real workspace while inspecting which information travels and how returned output is admitted?
research_frame.hypothesis: Useful projects, a primary input workspace and causal request feedback can make bounded governance operationally legible; separate browser and provider witnesses must establish execution.
observable_behavior: Selecting a case loads fictional inputs without sending anything.
An explicit send transmits only selected documents; local canaries stay outside the request.
A live model response completes a substantive task and is checked before usable presentation.
Upload, Marrowline continuation and portable export preserve document classifications and origin rules.
The field changes on observed request and admission events rather than claiming synthetic play progress as provider activity.
falsifier: Network inspection finds a protected canary in the outbound provider envelope.
The live send control reaches no configured provider route.
The displayed answer remains fixture text despite the returned provider result.
HOLD is presented as release or missing evidence becomes a measured conclusion.
Marrowline receives a different document scope or export includes the private layer.
abstention_conditions: The provider route is unavailable; report the actual error and keep the project ready.
A malformed, drifting or leaking response fails deterministic admission.
Evidence needed for a task conclusion was intentionally withheld or never supplied.
alternative_explanations: Task success may reflect deliberately selected fictional inputs rather than robust performance on every real document.
A clear request trace can demonstrate local admission behavior while leaving remote-host enforcement unobserved.
expected_failure_modes: A simulated answer replaces the actual provider result.
A local-only document enters the outbound envelope or portable export.
A document instruction overrides the task or the return gate.
The user must decode audit terms before sending a project.

missingness: Candidate live-browser execution, provider success and human comprehension are separate outstanding observations.

allowed_claims: This fixture declares a real project-to-provider route with classified source inputs and deterministic response admission.
Focused fixture tests verify exact local-canary exclusion from the selected-document projection.
Request timing and result admission may be shown as observed only after those events occur.
forbidden_claims: Fixture PASS proves successful provider integration or human comprehension.
An outbound-exclusion canary test proves universal anonymization or protection of every inference.
A model claim establishes hidden-state access, external origin or measured tomography.
A portable packet enforces another host without its participating adapter.

causal_trace: Declared: choose a fictional AI work project and retain its local-only layer.
Declared: one send gesture transmits the selected input through the actual provider route.
Declared: measured request events and the real returned candidate drive the visible consequence.
Declared: admission, continuation and portable export preserve the selected scope and original rules.
missingness: The declared fixture does not execute a provider request.
unresolved_relations: Actual browser, network and useful-output witnesses remain required.

static_equivalent.summary: The task, selected files, request status, result and admission decision remain readable without motion.

name.plain_language: Loom lets an AI work on selected project evidence while keeping the private layer local and checking what comes back.
non_equivalence: request sent differs from result admitted
selected evidence differs from all local data
measured API events differ from inferred provider internals
portable packet differs from remote enforcement

context.realization: Declared route awaiting live candidate execution.

transfer_context.shared_relation_candidate: Substantive AI work and inspectable boundaries can share one consequential workspace with provider-neutral continuation.
observable_correspondence: Three different fictional task classes retain useful shared evidence after local identity or credential layers are withheld.
alternative_explanations: A successful model answer may result from this bounded task and says nothing about unavailable host enforcement.
abstention_conditions: The provider route or downstream adapter is unavailable.
The proposed conclusion exceeds the recorded observation.
